scope: Delphi participant workspace route pagination contract
finding: The authenticated participant workspace route read limit and offset as raw query strings, so OpenAPI omitted the service bounds and malformed or out-of-range paging reached service validation.
change: The route now publishes limit 1..50 (default 50) and offset 0..10000 (default 0) in OpenAPI. FastAPI rejects malformed and out-of-range values before the handler invokes the workspace service.
rollback: Revert the route, focused tests, and this evidence file; no migration or persistent data changed.
limitations: This publishes the existing service bounds and does not establish browser, live identity-provider, or database acceptance.
